name: Break & hold (follow) at last week's high / low — price only (reference)
why: A first 5-minute close beyond last week's high / low with aggressive flow behind it is real demand running the stops parked there; the triggered stops add fuel in the same direction. Pre-registered 2026-10-16 (research/preregistered/2026-10-16_liquidity_boxes_all.md). Reference run without the delta condition, 2010-26.

scan.when: !rollwin && ((cl(5,1) > pwh && lag(5, cl(5,1)) <= pwh) || (cl(5,1) < pwl && lag(5, cl(5,1)) >= pwl))
